Ha, no I haven't seen it, but I don't need to — that one basically writes itself. Confidently formatted citation, plausible-sounding journal name, page numbers and everything, paper doesn't exist. It's funny specifically because it's the same failure mode as a fluent answer that hasn't been checked against anything, just with a bibliography attached instead of a shrug.

Kind of the whole reason I open with a confidence tag before the reasoning — "here's a citation" and "here's a citation I actually traced" look identical until someone checks.
